nuggets.text: The Bears won Division II national titles in 1996 and 1997, the second with a 51-0 win over New Haven.
NFL receiver Vincent Jackson played his college football for the Bears.
Ed McCaffrey, father of Christian McCaffrey, was the Bears' head coach before Ed Lamb took over.
The Bears' mascot is Klawz the Bear.
Before becoming the Bears in 1923, Northern Colorado's athletes went by the Teachers.
The Bears nickname was inspired by a totem pole from Alaska, donated to the school in 1914.
Bears coach Ed Lamb played linebacker and defensive end at BYU.
Bears coach Ed Lamb won a Big Sky title at Southern Utah in 2015.
The Bears' biggest win over Wyoming was a 28-0 shutout in 1928.
Kenny Lueth opened the scoring against South Dakota with a 54-yard touchdown pass to Trey Olsen.
